scope: Three alternating before/after pairs on temporary local files and disposable PostgreSQL. Artifact samples include real fsync with call-count instrumentation; authorization measures only the membership check using real verified unit files. Upload calls the route with generated chunks, preserves read-back verification and includes one separate tracemalloc run. Verified reads: three alternating pairs per workload, one first batch and seven warm batches per process/store; first batches follow fixture publication and are not cold OS-cache reads. Equality assertions are outside timing. Warm p95 is nearest-rank over 21 batches; traced allocation/work counts are separate instrumented batches. No OS cache flush, warmup exclusion, user data, providers, TCP upload, UI, whole-process RSS or power-loss measurement.
